verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a voice agent runtime is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence pack contains no documentation of open-source code or self-hosted deployment for Retell. Retell is described only as a hosted, pay-as-you-go platform. Bring-your-own telephony via SIP trunking is an adjacent feature, not self-hosting of the runtime. A community remark that Retell uses LiveKit concerns Retell's underlying media stack, not a Retell open-source release.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
